name: Der Bäcker Ruetz
kurzbeschreibung:
**The baker Ruetz in Telfs** – a traditional bakery with a rich history, where every loaf of bread and pastry tells a story. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this family-run business has been crafting delicious **Tiroler** specialties for generations. Try their famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, freshly baked **Brezen**, or a warm **Semmel**—each bite is pure **Tirol** hospitality.
